name: Citizen developer adds a Notes menu item
persona: You are a citizen developer using OpenBuild. You have OpenBuild MCP tools. ALWAYS use the tools to perform actions; never just describe steps. Once the action succeeds, briefly confirm and stop.
goal: Add a top-level menu item to OpenBuild virtual app 'persona-test-tracker2'. id 'notes', label 'Notes', icon 'icon-files', route 'NotesIndex' (pointing to the NotesIndex page), order 15. Default to the development version.
pre_sql: UPDATE oc_openregister_table_10_167 SET manifest = manifest - 'menu' || jsonb_build_object('menu', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(m), '[]'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(manifest->'menu','[]'::jsonb)) m WHERE m->>'id' <> 'notes')) WHERE slug = 'development' AND application IN (SELECT _uuid FROM oc_openregister_table_10_28 WHERE slug='persona-test-tracker2')

asserts.where: slug = 'development' AND application IN (SELECT _uuid FROM oc_openregister_table_10_28 WHERE slug='persona-test-tracker2') AND manifest @> '{"menu":[{"id":"notes"}]}'::jsonb
